<!doctype html>
<html lang="id" data-beasties-container>
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com">
    <title>Galura Data - Portal Open Data & Satu Data</title>
    <base href="/">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

    <!-- Baseline SEO. These are build-time defaults so crawlers still get a
         title, description and social preview if the SSR render or the
         settings API is unavailable. SeoService overwrites them per route via
         Meta.updateTag() once the app renders, and app.component swaps in the
         deployment's own region name and description from the settings API.
         Keep this copy region-neutral: one build serves every regional portal,
         and the region (nama_wilayah) only exists in the settings API at
         runtime, so naming a province here would be wrong everywhere else.
         Deliberately no canonical/og:url here: this build is deployed per
         region, so a hardcoded absolute URL would declare every other regional
         portal a duplicate of the Jabar one. SeoService.setCanonicalUrl()
         emits those per request instead. -->
    <meta name="description" content="Galura Data adalah portal resmi Open Data dan Satu Data pemerintah daerah. Cari, lihat, dan unduh dataset, peta, infografik, dan publikasi terbuka dari perangkat daerah.">
    <meta name="robots" content="index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1">
    <meta property="og:type" content="website">
    <meta property="og:site_name" content="Galura Data">
    <meta property="og:locale" content="id_ID">
    <meta property="og:title" content="Galura Data - Portal Open Data & Satu Data">
    <meta property="og:description" content="Data resmi dari Pemerintah Daerah untuk berbagai data terbuka dari pemerintah untuk membantu Anda mengambil keputusan yang lebih baik untuk usaha, studi, riset, maupun kebutuhan sehari-hari.">
    <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
    <meta name="twitter:title" content="Galura Data - Portal Open Data & Satu Data">
    <meta name="twitter:description" content="Galura Data adalah portal resmi Open Data dan Satu Data pemerintah daerah. Cari, lihat, dan unduh dataset, peta, infografik, dan publikasi terbuka dari perangkat daerah.">
    <link id="appIcon" rel="icon" href="favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">

         only when the Hotline feature is active in the admin Fitur page.
         The bubble is a plain <button> in this page
         (only the chat window itself is an iframe), so page CSS can restyle it.
         The SDK paints the inbox's widget colour onto the button as an inline
         `background` and injects its own sheet after this block, so every
         declaration here needs !important to win. Scoped with :not(.woot--close)
         because the close (X) button is a second element sharing the class. -->
    <style>

        background-size: cover !important;

          0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32) !important;

         only when the Hotline feature is active in the admin Fitur page.
         The bubble is a plain <button> in this page
         (only the chat window itself is an iframe), so page CSS can restyle it.
         The SDK paints the inbox's widget colour onto the button as an inline
         `background` and injects its own sheet after this block, so every
         declaration here needs !important to win. Scoped with :not(.woot--close)
         because the close (X) button is a second element sharing the class. -->
    <style>

        background-size: cover !important;

          0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) !important;

        box-shadow:
          0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08),
          0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32) !important;

         only when the Hotline feature is active in the admin Fitur page.
         The bubble is a plain <button> in this page
         (only the chat window itself is an iframe), so page CSS can restyle it.
         The SDK paints the inbox's widget colour onto the button as an inline
         `background` and injects its own sheet after this block, so every
         declaration here needs !important to win. Scoped with :not(.woot--close)
         because the close (X) button is a second element sharing the class. -->
    <style>

        background-position: center !important;

        background-size: cover !important;

          0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) !important;

        box-shadow:
          0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08),
          0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32) !important;
      }

      .woot-widget-bubble:not(.woot--close) svg {

         title, description and social preview if the SSR render or the
         settings API is unavailable. SeoService overwrites them per route via

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id" data-beasties-container>
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com">
    <title>Galura Data - Portal Open Data & Satu Data</title>
    <base href="/">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

    <!-- Baseline SEO. These are build-time defaults so crawlers still get a
         title, description and social preview if the SSR render or the
         settings API is unavailable. SeoService overwrites them per route via
         Meta.updateTag() once the app renders, and app.component swaps in the
         deployment's own region name and description from the settings API.
         Keep this copy region-neutral: one build serves every regional portal,
         and the region (nama_wilayah) only exists in the settings API at
         runtime, so naming a province here would be wrong everywhere else.
         Deliberately no canonical/og:url here: this build is deployed per
         region, so a hardcoded absolute URL would declare every other regional
         portal a duplicate of the Jabar one. SeoService.setCanonicalUrl()
         emits those per request instead. -->

         only when the Hotline feature is active in the admin Fitur page.
         The bubble is a plain <button> in this page
         (only the chat window itself is an iframe), so page CSS can restyle it.
         The SDK paints the inbox's widget colour onto the button as an inline
         `background` and injects its own sheet after this block, so every
         declaration here needs !important to win. Scoped with :not(.woot--close)
         because the close (X) button is a second element sharing the class. -->
    <style>

        background-size: cover !important;

          0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32) !important;

         only when the Hotline feature is active in the admin Fitur page.
         The bubble is a plain <button> in this page
         (only the chat window itself is an iframe), so page CSS can restyle it.
         The SDK paints the inbox's widget colour onto the button as an inline
         `background` and injects its own sheet after this block, so every
         declaration here needs !important to win. Scoped with :not(.woot--close)
         because the close (X) button is a second element sharing the class. -->
    <style>

        background-size: cover !important;

          0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) !important;

        box-shadow:
          0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08),
          0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32) !important;

  • bps_kode_kecamatan: menyatakan kode dari setiap kecamatan di Provinsi Jawa Barat sesuai ketentuan BPS merujuk pada aturan Peraturan Badan Pusat Statistik Nomor 3 Tahun 2019 dengan tipe data numerik.
